title: Admins can assign module access that sticks
description:
The desktop Admin tab uses the same user list as the web portal. Saving module access for a customer account used to clear those flags, and Daily Reports could not be turned off.

An admin can leave PipeShare, PipeSync, Plan View, Footage, Pricing, Reports, AUTOSYNC, jobsite contacts, and email on or off for that person. Reports stays on for existing accounts until an admin turns it off. A new account can store an email address.

Who is affected: admins on the private server and on SaaS. A tenant admin still only sees users in their own client. The person whose access changed should sign in again before the new modules apply.
changeLog: Customer accounts keep the modules an admin assigns.
Daily Reports can be turned off. Existing accounts keep it until an admin changes it.
Creating a user can store an email address.
A tenant admin still only manages users in their own client.
